title: CONTROLLER B CLOSES SETTINGS
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: with MINIMAP ZOOM set to CLOSE, pressing B on a controller in Settings did not shut the window. B looks for the first button whose words read like a way out, and the MINIMAP ZOOM row reading CLOSE comes before the window CLOSE button, so B clicked the row: the zoom went from CLOSE to STANDARD and Settings stayed open. Proven in headless Chromium through the real pad poll: {"zoomBtn":"CLOSE","openAfterB":true,"span1":1000,"zoomBtn2":"STANDARD"}. B now skips the Settings option rows, so it reaches the window CLOSE button.
now: B on a controller now closes Settings even when MINIMAP ZOOM is set to CLOSE, and leaves the zoom alone.
